promptTemplate:
Bug report: {{task}}

Run the /fix workflow: two-phase reproduction before any production edit, approved plan before implementation, bounded rework on failure. The confirmed reproduction is an immutable oracle.

stages.label: Intake
stages.instructions: Classify the bug report: expected vs actual behavior, affected surface, severity, and reproduction hints. Record a journal 'plan' entry with the classification. If the report is not actionable, checkpoint with outcome 'blocked'.

stages.label: Repro explore (read-only)
stages.instructions: Read and search only: locate the bug, note prior reproductions, test conventions, and similar incidents via kxm context. No source or test edits. Produce a diagnosis: bug location, root-cause hypothesis, expected/actual behavior, reproduction strategy, reference tests, and target assertions. Record the diagnosis with journal category 'hypothesis'.

stages.label: Repro write (tests only)
stages.instructions: Write the failing reproduction. Tests and helpers only — production code stays read-only. The reproduction must fail for the reported reason. Cite evidence key 'repro' as '<test-file>:<sha256 of test content>'. Once this stage passes, the reproduction becomes an immutable oracle: later stages must cite the same value and a weakened reproduction is rejected.

stages.label: Plan
stages.instructions: Using the diagnosis and the confirmed reproduction, write the implementation plan: changed files, approach, risks, and how the reproduction proves the fix. Cite evidence key 'plan' with the plan artifact path and content hash.

stages.label: Independent critics
stages.instructions: Two independent critics review the plan for correctness, scope creep, and risk. Both must reply through the mesh; caller-authored evidence cannot satisfy this policy. If the plan is invalidated, checkpoint with outcome 'plan_invalidated'.

stages.label: Final plan
stages.instructions: Fold critic feedback into the final plan. Re-cite evidence key 'plan' with the final artifact path and content hash. The hash of this stage's plan evidence becomes the approved plan hash required by implementation.

stages.label: Human approval
stages.instructions: Human operator approves the plan. Cite evidence key 'signoff' with the approver identity and approval reference. A 'rejected' outcome routes back to planning; this stage cannot be bypassed by any transition.

stages.label: Implement
stages.instructions: Implement the approved plan. The reproduction oracle is immutable: local verification must fail before the fix and pass after it. Cite evidence keys 'diff' and 'repro' (same value as the oracle).

stages.label: Local verify
stages.instructions: Run the repo-defined gates: unit, lint, typecheck, build, and the confirmed reproduction test. Cite evidence key 'gates' with per-gate results. 'implementation_failure' reworks implementation; 'plan_invalidated' routes back to planning rather than expanding scope.

stages.label: Delivery
stages.instructions: Create and push the branch and merge request with the reproduction, plan, and diff references. Delivery never auto-merges: CI and review outcomes are watched in the next stage.

stages.label: CI and review watch
stages.instructions: Watch required CI checks and review status. On failure, checkpoint with outcome 'failure' to rework through bounded transitions. On success, continue to human acceptance.

stages.label: Ready for human acceptance
stages.instructions: Summarize the fix: reproduction (immutable oracle), approved plan hash, diff, gate results, CI outcome, and the full claim-to-evidence trail from the run journal. Checkpoint 'passed' to complete the run; a human performs final acceptance outside the workflow.
